title: Nice to meet you

title: Tell me about yourself
scene: After class Anna and Max talk about their background: Max came to Kyiv as a teenager, and Anna's dad has a small business. They talk about hobbies, their favorite season, the type of music they are fans of and their character - Max is very friendly - then swap contacts and say goodbye.

scene: Max has an idea for the weekend and tells Anna a secret: his bro can lend them a car, so they have a chance to go to Lviv. Anna thinks it is a super plan that makes sense; they talk about the details, and in fact they leave on Saturday.

scene: Anna and Max have lunch at a small café near college. They read the menu: Max orders soup and a sandwich, Anna takes a salad with dressing and chicken with rice and sauce, and for dessert she wants tea with lemon.

scene: Max meets Anna at a coffee shop with a great vibe, full of hipsters with laptops. The barista makes a latte from a new blend and a cappuccino with caramel - Max is a real coffee snob - and they take a croissant and a muffin.

scene: Max wants to chill at home with friends and watch a movie. They order a big pizza for delivery and choose the toppings, pepperoni and mozzarella - the diameter is forty centimeters - get cola, nachos and other snacks, and make popcorn.

scene: After the cinema Max wants fast food, so they go to a burger place with a drive-through. Max orders a burger with ketchup and mayonnaise and a milkshake, Anna takes a sundae, and Max's older cousin orders a cold lager.

scene: Anna and Max shop at the supermarket for a dinner with friends. They buy a kilo of tomatoes, two liters of milk, broccoli, an avocado, citrus fruit, a mango, kiwis and tangerines, and cheddar, salami and crackers.

title: Cooking for a vegan friend
scene: Anna's friend Lisa is a vegan and cannot eat gluten. Anna cooks tofu in a wok on the gas stove with kale and zucchini, makes a curry with chili and some hummus, but forgets to turn off the gas, and the dinner is almost a fiasco.
